title: Kulbergs' party holds lead in polls with election looming
summary_full: Support for Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs' political force "United List" (AS) grew in August, but the popularity of other coalition parties decreased, according to a survey conducted for Latvian Television by SKDS from August 13 to 19.
